title: Police identify man shot dead by officer in northern B.C.
article: Police released Monday the identity of a man fatally shot by an RCMP officer after an attempted break-and- enter.
Kevin Edmond St. Arnaud, 29, of Vanderhoof died Sunday morning after three shots were fired.
The shooting is under investigation by the North District Major Crimes Unit.
The officer is at home on regular days off. His name has not been released.
"Like anyone would be, he was shaken by the incident," said Const. Mike Caira.
"He is certainly going to be provided with the members' assistance program, which provides personal and emotional support and counselling after any traumatic incident."

The officer, who has been with the RCMP since 2002, was not injured in the altercation. He was one of two Vanderhoof members who attended a late-night alarm at a pharmacy at the Vanderhoof Co-op Mall.
Police said the suspect turned and advanced on the officer "in a threatening manner."
